purpose: Attorney demonstration and tour pathway coherence audit.
materialFindings: The current full attorney tour is substantially newer and clearer than downstream professional profile/account pages.
professionals.html still exposes temporary, compatibility, legacy, and focused-portal migration language inconsistent with the one-platform public model.
attorney-launch.html still frames the professional record around four focused portals rather than the broader Smarter Justice legal-area model.
professional-signup.html still exposes focused micro-portal terminology and an annual billing option that conflicts with the membership page's monthly-only approved pilot cadence.
The demonstration should use one coherent path and one vocabulary from first screen through profile/account next action.
decision: Prioritize the attorney demonstration pathway ahead of additional jurisdiction expansion or non-demo currentness refinements for pre50.
